package course

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
)

// DeleteCourseInput holds input values.
type DeleteCourseInput struct {
	CourseID string
}

// DeleteCourse marks course as inactive.
type DeleteCourse struct {
	Courses   repository.CourseRepository
	Publisher domain.EventPublisher
}

// Handle performs deletion and emits event.
func (uc DeleteCourse) Handle(ctx context.Context, in DeleteCourseInput) error {
	course, err := uc.Courses.GetByID(ctx, in.CourseID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}

	if err := uc.Courses.Delete(ctx, in.CourseID); err != nil {
		return err
	}

	_ = uc.Publisher.Publish(ctx, domain.SubjectCourseDeleted, map[string]any{
		"course_id": course.ID,
		"slug":      course.Slug,
	})

	return nil
}
